source_import.notes: 16 Australian meetings imported: 12 Racing Australia official final-fields sheets and 4 Racing & Sports race-field sheets. Five other meetings from the 21-meeting day listing are not included because a complete reliable field sheet was not retrieved. This is a fields-only import: official last-10 strings and career statistics are retained where supplied, but full dated form lines, sectionals, trials/jump-outs, speed maps and independent runner reviews are not parsed. Scratched and emergency statuses are only those visible in the source sheets. No final-starter attestation, no approved selections and no calibrated win probabilities.
